description: This Java source file is an integration test class for testing full amount chargeback scenarios on overpaid loans within the Apache Fineract project. It contains setup methods, parameterized tests for different loan product configurations, and helper methods to create loans, clients, and perform transactions, verifying correct handling of overpayments and chargebacks.

classes.name: LoanTransactionFullAmountChargebackForOverpaidLoanTest
classes.description: A JUnit integration test class that verifies the correct handling of full amount chargeback transactions on overpaid loans in various loan product configurations within Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST assured settings and request/response specifications before each test execution.

methods.name: loanTransactionChargebackOfFullAmountForOverpaidLoanTest
methods.description: Parameterized test that creates a loan, makes multiple repayments, performs a chargeback on the overpaid amount, and verifies the financial transaction states and loan status after chargeback.

methods.name: createLoanProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan product with specified parameters including delinquency bucket and strategy.

methods.name: createLoanAccount
methods.description: Helper method to create a loan account for a client with a specified loan product and external ID, then approve and disburse it.

methods.name: createRepaymentPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Constructs an AdvancedPaymentData object for repayment transactions with custom payment allocation order.

methods.name: createDefaultPaymentAllocation
methods.description: Constructs an AdvancedPaymentData object for default payment allocation with standard order.

methods.name: getPaymentAllocationOrder
methods.description: Utility method to generate a list of PaymentAllocationOrder objects from given PaymentAllocationType enums.

methods.name: loanProductFactory
methods.description: Provides a stream of arguments, each with a different loan product configuration for parameterized testing.
